title: Concept: Compressed database dump in the served tree
description: A gzip or zip archive whose name marks it as a dump in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The archive holds whole tables, so one download is a full copy of the data the application was trusted with.
applicability: Deployments that render a gzip or zip archive whose name marks it as a dump into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The archive holds whole tables, so one download is a full copy of the data the application was trusted with.
